target_customer: Large ecommerce and subscription brands running email through Klaviyo and similar ESPs
problem: Marketing emails are static, so shoppers must click out to buy, swap or skip a subscription. Brands also pay agencies about $70k a year for email programs that run few tests.
business_model: B2B SaaS design tool for interactive email blocks, expanding to AI agents that run email programs
product_category: Interactive email and ecommerce marketing automation

founders.name: Brice Douglas
prior_employers: Corporate strategy group of a public YC company (unnamed)
education: Dropped out of university (name not given on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was heavily involved with the largest student-run venture firm.

founders.name: Daniel Jones
founders.background_notes: YC page says he won $900k+ in pitch competitions in undergrad.

founders.name: Santiago Gomez Paz
founders.background_notes: YC page names Santi as cofounder; surname from a search profile, not the YC page.

competitors.name: Mailmodo
competitors.funding_then: $270K pre-seed led by Titan, per Entrepreneur

technical_complexity.rationale: AMP for email plus HTML fallbacks for clients like Outlook and integrations with Shopify and subscription platforms; hard parts are client compatibility, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded in brands' email programs and subscription integrations, but the wedge could be copied by ESPs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Klaviyo remained the ESP Zaymo works alongside; no copying by Klaviyo found in searches.

market_need_then: A PM at Turing.com reported a 3x conversion boost from interactive emails in A/B tests (YC page); subscription brands wanted in-inbox swap and skip.

branding.domain_note: Uses zaymo.com; earlier getzaymo.com mentioned by an aggregator, history not sourced
branding.brand_signature: Interactive email blocks inside the inbox

brand_strength.rationale: Customer logos and case studies drive credibility; no press on the brand itself found.

pivots.to: AI agents that run email programs for brands
pivots.why: YC description says the interactive email wedge now feeds agents that audit, write and test campaigns; date not stated

outcome_analysis: Zaymo is active and says it has about 500 brands, $5M ARR growing 5x and is cash-flow positive, per the YC listing. Its wedge of interactive email closed most brands it pitched. The raise was small, a $700K pre-seed in 2023, and growth appears funded by revenue. Claims are company-stated and the move into agents is recent.
notes: The techbuzznews page could not be fetched (safety check rate-limited); the $700K figure comes from its search summary and matches Seedtable and ZoomInfo. VCBacked, FundedIQ and CB Insights list a $500K round in 2024 and CB Insights lists a convertible note with Hat-Trick Capital, Orange Collective and FJOR; unverified and not recorded as rounds. Competitor Mailmodo is dated 2020 because no source dated near the batch was found. Klaviyo AMP support was described as limited in a vendor comparison.
